question: How much did HappyRobot raise in its latest funding round?

hits.title: HappyRobot is worth $1.2 billion. Its founder says it’s just ‘getting started’ | Fortune
hits.snippet: HappyRobot, the startup that builds AI agents to run the phone calls, emails, and scheduling that keep supply chains moving, just raised a $150 million Series C at a $1.2 billion valuation, Fortune learned exclusively.

hits.title: HappyRobot Vaults to $1.2 Billion Valuation as Enterprise Demand for AI Automation Soars | PYMNTS.com
hits.snippet: AI agent platform HappyRobot was valued at $1.2 billion post-money in a Series C funding round in which it raised $150 million.

hits.title: HappyRobot Raises $150 Million Series C to Build Enterprise Superintelligence
hits.snippet: HappyRobot has raised $150 million in Series C funding led by Prysm Capital and co-led by Eurazeo.

hits.title: HappyRobot raises $44 million to expand AI agents for freight operators | Reuters
hits.snippet: Sept 3 (Reuters) - HappyRobot, an artificial intelligence startup that automates communications including rate negotiation and appointment booking for freight operators, has raised $44 million in a funding round led by Base10 Partners.

hits.snippet: We're excited to share that we've raised $150 million in Series C funding, led by Prysm Capital and co-led by Eurazeo. Existing investors a16z, Base10, and Y Combinator are doubling down, joined by strategics including Koch Disruptive Technologies ...
